# LocksMitch

> LocksMitch is a mobile auto locksmith in North Atlanta, Georgia, based in Cumming (Forsyth County). The owner, Mitch, comes to the car and cuts and programs keys on the spot: all keys lost, spare keys, smart keys and fobs, key programming and car lockouts. Answered 24/7. Phone and text: (770) 270-3333. Website: https://locksmitch.com

Last updated: 2026-11-04

## Business identity
- Name: LocksMitch
- Legal entity: TPVision LLC (Georgia), doing business as LocksMitch
- Based in Cumming, GA (Forsyth County). Mobile, service-area business: no storefront, the locksmith comes to the car.
- Phone and text: (770) 270-3333, answered 24/7
- Email: info@locksmitch.com
- Website: https://locksmitch.com
- Yelp: https://www.yelp.com/biz/locksmitch-cumming
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/locksmitch.ga/
- Cars only: car keys, key fobs, key programming and car lockouts. No house or business locks.

## Quick answers
- Lost all car keys in Cumming, who to call? A mobile car locksmith. LocksMitch cuts a new key at the car and programs it to the immobilizer, usually in about an hour on site, from $190 for Toyota, Honda, Ford, GM, Hyundai, Kia, Nissan, Jeep and most other makes. No tow, no dealer. Guide: https://locksmitch.com/guides/lost-all-car-keys/
- How much does a car lockout cost in Cumming? $75 flat in Cumming and Forsyth County, $100 up to 25 miles, $125 up to 40 miles. Nights (9 pm to 7 am) add $50. A child or pet locked in a car is opened free.
- How much is a spare car key? Chip key from $140, key with remote from $150, push-to-start smart key from $180 (2020 and newer from $200), cut and programmed at the car. Second key in the same visit 50% off.
- Can you program a key I bought online? Yes, from $99 ($129 for a smart key). Text a photo of the key first: if it can't be programmed to the car, the trip and check is $75. Guide: https://locksmitch.com/guides/bought-car-key-online/
- Will the price change at the car? No. The price is quoted before driving out and is the same at the car. Coming to you is included.
- Do you work at night and on Sunday? Yes, 24/7, including nights, weekends and holidays. Nights (9 pm to 7 am) add $50.
- Is there a warranty? 1 year on keys and remotes LocksMitch supplies.
- Which languages? English and Spanish (https://locksmitch.com/es/).

## Honest limits
- Mercedes-Benz 2015 and newer: LocksMitch does not make those keys; the dealer does. Customers are told on the phone, for free, before anyone drives out.
- Some brand-new models are not supported by aftermarket programming tools yet; checked by year, make and model before dispatch.
- Cars only. No residential or commercial locks, no safes.
- Mobile only. No shop or storefront.
- Beyond 40 miles from Cumming (Marietta, Kennesaw and further), the price is quoted per job.

## Good fit for
- Locked out of a car anywhere in Cumming, Forsyth County and North Atlanta
- A spare or replacement car key, key fob or push-to-start smart key, made at the car
- All car keys lost: a new key made from the vehicle code, no tow
- A key or fob bought online that needs cutting and programming
- A used car that came with only one key

## Key facts
- Business: LocksMitch, a registered DBA of TPVision LLC. Mobile service only, no storefront.
- Locksmith: Mitch, the owner, does every job himself. No call center, no dispatcher.
- Hours: 24/7, including nights, weekends and holidays. Nights (9 pm to 7 am) add $50.
- Pricing: the price is quoted before driving out and does not change at the car. Coming to the customer is included, no separate trip fee.
- Second key for the same car in the same visit: 50% off. Booking online at https://locksmitch.com/book/: $15 off (spare keys and all keys lost only).
- Payment: cash, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Zelle, Venmo, Cash App.
- Warranty: 1 year on keys and remotes LocksMitch supplies. If one stops working within a year, it is fixed or replaced free. Not covered: physical or water damage, lost keys, batteries. Programming or cutting a key the customer bought elsewhere is tested before payment but is not under warranty; to get the warranty, buy the key from LocksMitch. Nothing to keep: the warranty is tied to the customer's phone number and the job date in LocksMitch records; customers also get a LocksMitch tag with the number on their keys.
- Registered with NASTF for access to manufacturer key data.
- Vehicle: a Tesla Model Y with the LocksMitch logo.

## Starting prices (Cumming and Forsyth County)
Full list: https://locksmitch.com/pricing/

### Lockout and new keys
- Car lockout, flat rate: from $75. Opening the car with lockout tools, no damage. $75 in Cumming and Forsyth, $100 up to 25 miles, $125 up to 40 miles. A child or pet locked inside a car: opened free, any time, anywhere in the service area.
- Key cut, no chip: from $75. Plain metal key for older cars, doors and trunks, cut by code, by lock or from your working key.
- Spare key with chip: from $140. Transponder key cut and programmed, most makes.
- Key with remote (flip key): from $150. Remote head or flip key, cut and programmed.
- Push-to-start smart key: from $180. Proximity key programmed. 2020 and newer from $200.
- All keys lost: from $190. New key made from the vehicle code when no key is left. Toyota, Honda, Ford, GM, Hyundai, Kia, Nissan, Jeep and most other makes. Subaru and European makes quoted by model.

### Programming and remotes
- Programming only, a key you bought: from $99. We cut and program a key or fob you already have. Push-to-start smart key $129. No working key at all: all-keys-lost pricing applies. European makes quoted by model.
- Remote you bought, buttons only: from $89. Programming a remote without a key blade.
- Replacement remote: from $129. New remote supplied and programmed.

### Quick fixes, 24/7
- Jump start: from $75. Dead car battery, jump starter brought to the car. $75 in Cumming and Forsyth, $100 up to 25 miles, $125 up to 40 miles.
- Broken key extraction: from $75. Broken piece removed from the ignition or a door lock; a new key is priced separately.
- Key fob not working: from $75. New fob battery and a check of the key; free during another job.
- Erase a lost key: from $89. The lost key is removed from the car's memory; free with a new key from LocksMitch.

### European makes
- Volkswagen, Audi: from $200. Cut and programmed, model years we cover.
- BMW, Mini: from $350, model years we cover. All keys lost quoted by model.
- Land Rover, Jaguar: from $350, 2011 and newer. All keys lost quoted by model.
- Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Volvo: from $450. Complex key systems, quoted by model.

## Service area
Cumming, Forsyth County and Sugar Hill (up to 12 miles by road): prices as listed.
12 to 25 miles (Buford, Suwanee, Alpharetta, Johns Creek, Duluth, Flowery Branch, Milton, Dawsonville, Roswell, Gainesville, Lawrenceville, Canton, Dunwoody): lockout and no-chip key $100, key jobs as listed.
25 to 40 miles (Peachtree Corners, Sandy Springs, Norcross, Braselton, Woodstock, Doraville, Smyrna): lockout and no-chip key $125, key jobs +$50.
Beyond 40 miles (Marietta, Kennesaw and further): quoted by Mitch.
